profile_conditions.PRESEARCH_SIGNAL: Phase-0 establishes a certificate-shape failure, resolved status, public prior art, formalization mismatch, corrupt statement, or identity ambiguity.
profile_conditions.CROSSING_SIGNAL: The literal residual is replayable and one frozen transformation has a nonzero signed effect toward crossing while preserving every checked hypothesis, with no theorem baseline forbidding that direction.
profile_conditions.THEOREM_SIGNAL: A named theorem baseline or complete bounded structural argument forces the observed wall and blocks the proposed crossing direction.
profile_conditions.ZERO_SIGNAL: A complete finite domain or operation class is frozen and fits the arm budgets, with no signed wall transformation qualifying as CROSSING_SIGNAL.
profile_conditions.TIMEOUT_SIGNAL: The literal residual is replayable but neither a qualifying signed transformation nor a complete in-budget domain nor a theorem signal is available.
profile_conditions.NEUTRAL_STRATUM_PRIOR: Used only when no earlier condition is decidable; copy the selection stratum prior.
